column1: # The kind registry, version 1. One row per (system, kind); the system owner adds rows for its own system.
# kind: three letters a-z. The kind sys belongs to the format (the system itself, in every system) and has no row.
# role: entity, activation, command, run, stream, store, database, transaction, correlation or request.
# state: live, closed or retired; a kind is never deleted or reassigned. served_by: "-" or the code that serves it now.
# The kinds of brd are kept as history; nothing mints under brd.
